description:
You are a genomics researcher who needs to document a new RNA-seq quality control pipeline in SciNote ELN. Your team is running bulk RNA sequencing on tumor vs. normal tissue samples and needs comprehensive experimental records for regulatory compliance and reproducibility.

Set up the complete ELN documentation with this structure:

Project: 'RNA-seq Quality Control Pipeline'

Create two experiments inside this project:
1. 'Library QC Assessment' — with four tasks forming a sequential workflow: 'RNA Extraction' → 'RNA Quality Assessment' → 'Library Preparation' → 'Library Quantification' (connect them in this order)
2. 'Bioinformatics Pipeline' — with three tasks: 'Read Trimming' → 'Reference Alignment' → 'Expression Quantification' (connect them in this order)

Add a protocol with at least 6 steps to the 'Library Preparation' task in the first experiment (e.g., fragmentation, first-strand synthesis, second-strand synthesis, end repair, adapter ligation, PCR amplification).

Create an inventory called 'RNA-seq Reagents' with four columns: 'Supplier', 'Catalog Number', 'Concentration', 'Storage Temperature'. Add these four items:
- 'RNeasy Plus Mini Kit'
- 'KAPA Stranded mRNA-seq Kit'
- 'ERCC RNA Spike-In Mix'
- 'DNase I (RNase-free)'

Login Credentials:
- E-mail: admin@scinote.net
- Password: inHisHouseAtRlyehDeadCthulhuWaitsDreaming
